search_power_sensors: search for power sensors under /sys/class/hwmon and return sensor info as a list of dicts
set_sensor_avg_interval: set the average interval of a power sensor to a specified value in milliseconds
get_sensor_avg_power: get the average power reading of a sensor in watts from the power1_average sysfs file
run_power_collector: start a background thread that periodically collects power readings from all detected sensors
terminate_power_collector: stop the power collector thread and restore sensor intervals to their original values
